features: Ultra HD 4K Support: Elevate your viewing experience with the Projector, featuring 720p native resolution and compatibility with 4K video, offering unmatched clarity and detail in your home theatre.

Large Screen Display: Our smart projector can produce a massive 150-inch display, making it perfect for creating your own big-screen experience at home. It is ideal for anyone seeking an immersive, expansive visual setup.
180° Swivel: Easily adjust the projector’s angle to match your projection preference for optimal viewing in any room, ensuring a perfect setup every time.
Integrated Sound System: Comes equipped with a powerful 3W speaker that delivers clear, room-filling audio, ensuring an immersive sound experience for all your movies and presentations.
Brilliant Brightness: With 4000 lumens of brightness, our home projector cuts through ambient light, delivering vibrant visuals in any setting, day or night.
Accurate Image Adjustment: Hassle-free setup with Manual Focus and Auto Keystone correction, allowing you to achieve the perfect picture alignment quickly and easily.
description: 【WIFI 6 Wireless Smart Projector】Say goodbye to traditional HDMI cable conversion projection, this smart projector is built-in WiFi6. Faster transmission rate and lower transmission delay, easily and quickly connect to smartphones, laptops, etc., within 5 seconds to connect successfully, to achieve fast and stable projection of video, games and so on.
